However, existing memory systems contain a vulnerability in role-to-principal attribution that attackers can exploit. We identify Role Grounding Misattribution, in which an attacker-designed interaction causes the victim agent to incorrectly record a preference from the attacker as a preference of the victim's user. papers.title: A Conditional Mutual Information Analysis of Response Variety in Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models provide a variety of responses at inference (generation) that conventionally depend on a temperature parameter. Using a conditional mutual information approach, a quantitative, entropy based analysis of response variety is given. Three limiting behaviors are defined: arbiter, independent (conditionally) and neutral (deterministic) that span no to maximal mutual information. We give examples of each behavior and suggest their application to: temperature analysis, language analysis, prompt compression, and knowledge graphs.

papers.title: Fundamental Limits and Joint Design for Monostatic Joint Communications and Sensing in LEO Satellites
papers.abstract: Monostatic joint communication and sensing (JCAS) from a low-Earth-orbit (LEO) satellite requires full-duplex (FD) operation, with self-interference (SI) $80$--$100$~dB stronger than the ground echo. papers.abstract: Split Inference (SI) addresses the hardware resource limitations of Internet of Things (IoT) devices by distributing tiny Machine Learning (TinyML) model segments across multiple IoT devices.
